title: 3.2 I'm, you're, we're
unit_title: Meeting people and talking about them
unit_outcome: Introduce people and answer introductions, use the short forms of be, answer yes/no questions in short, compare ages, talk about languages, nationalities and jobs, describe people, say whose things are, give an address and say what you want to be.
goal: Use the short forms I'm, you're and we're (I'm at the gym. / You're tall. / We're in the park.).
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 3.2 I, You, and We: A1 says I am, you are and we are; A1+ 3.2 uses the short forms people say. The one new grammar relationship is the contraction of am and are after I, you and we (I'm, you're, we're), taught against the full forms (I am at the gym. / I'm at the gym.). Speaker perspective stays explicit: a person alone says I'm, two people together say we're, and you're is said to the other person in the photo (Sofia and Luis back to back: You're tall. / I'm short.).
prerequisite: A1 3.2 I am, you are, we are; A1 4.3 in; A1 4.10 at; A1 1.11 friends; A1+ 1.1 tall and short; A1+ 2.1 the gym, the pool, the office and the park, and go to.
speaking_outcome: Say I'm as one syllable ending in m, you're like your, and we're like weer; never add a vowel between the pronoun and the short form. Do not require native-like speed.
